paragraphs.text: Tuck is a human warrior on the plane of Vryn .

When Tuck was 14, he, Caden and Jillet tracked down Jace Beleren on top of a mage-ring and bullied him until he fell off the edge. He clung to the tip, and invaded Caden's mind, taking him over and helping himself up.
While creating the Echoverse , Jace subconsciously drew upon the memory of his childhood bully to create the Repurposed Enforcer s, using them to maintain control over Hexhaven .
